# Town of Readsboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 141 (Town of Readsboro): the Readsboro charter makes the Selectboard the legislative body and leaves town officers to general law
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Readsboro, 'Positions for Election March 2026' (readsborovt.org): the offices standing in 2026 are a Selectboard three-year seat, a Library Trustee five-year seat, a Cemetery Commissioner five-year seat, Moderator, Town Clerk (three years), and Town Treasurer (three years); no Town Agent, lister, or auditor position is listed. Bill LeQuier held the seat to 2026 per the town officers table; the 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 141 (Town of Readsboro): town officers follow general law under the merger charter
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Readsboro, 2025 Town Report, READSBORO TOWN OFFICERS table: Amber Holland, Town Clerk on a term expiring at the 2026 meeting

Town of Readsboro, 'Positions for Election March 2026' (readsborovt.org): the offices standing in 2026 are a Selectboard three-year seat, a Library Trustee five-year seat, a Cemetery Commissioner five-year seat, Moderator, Town Clerk (three years), and Town Treasurer (three years); no Town Agent, lister, or auditor position is listed
Town of Readsboro, minutes of the March 2, 2026 annual meeting (adopted): the promised election results do not appear in the minutes; Amber Holland still acted as clerk on March 24, 2026

Town of Readsboro, Town Info page (readsborovt.org): the current Town Clerk is Cheryl Green. With Holland's elected term expired, no 2026 winner published, and the town having advertised the combined Clerk/Treasurer position as a job, Green is recorded as appointed (disclosed inference, batch-18 Plainfield pattern)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 141 (Town of Readsboro): town officers follow general law under the merger charter
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Readsboro, 2025 Town Report, READSBORO TOWN OFFICERS table: Amber Holland, Town Treasurer on a term expiring at the 2026 meeting
Town of Readsboro, Town Info page (readsborovt.org): the current Town Treasurer is Cheryl Green; recorded as appointed on the same disclosed inference as the clerkship

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Readsboro's three selectboard members: Joseph Berard, Raymond Eilers, and Bartholomew Howes

Town of Readsboro, Boards & Commissions page (readsborovt.org): Joseph Berard (Chair), Raymond Eilers (Vice Chair), and Bartholomew Howes. Nathan Kurz's term expired in 2026 and the one standing three-year seat was Howes's

Bachand sits in Dente's seat, whose term ran to 2029, so he is recorded as appointed to the mid-term vacancy (instrument unpublished, disclosed)
